Title: Kunal's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Kunal - 12 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Anjali - 34 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Kunal stands in the park. Anjali stands near him.]

Anjali: "What lovely weather!"

[Kunal catches the ball.]

Anjali: "Hey, look at that!"

[Kunal kicks the football hard.]

Kunal: "Yes, of course."

[Kunal plays cricket in the park.]

Kunal (happily): "What happened?"

[Kunal goes down the slide.]

Kunal (softly): "That was fun!"

[Kunal plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Anjali (excited): "And then?"

[Kunal feeds the birds.]

Anjali: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
